home.faq1A: Captura is a web app for collecting photos and videos from event guests. Create a shared album, generate a QR code, and guests scan it to upload directly from their phone — no app download or account required.
home.faq2Q: Do guests need to download an app to upload photos?
home.faq2A: No. Guests scan a QR code which opens a page in their phone's browser. They enter their name and upload photos or videos. Zero friction, zero downloads.
home.faq3Q: What events is Captura good for?
home.faq3A: Weddings, birthday parties, corporate events, reunions, graduations, baby showers, sports events, conferences — any occasion where you want to crowdsource photos from attendees.
home.faq4Q: Can I collect photos from wedding guests without an app?
home.faq4A: Yes. Captura is designed exactly for this. Print or display a QR code at your venue. Guests scan and upload from any phone browser. You download everything as a ZIP after the event.
home.faq5Q: How does the face detection work?
home.faq5A: After guests upload photos, Captura automatically detects and groups faces. As the album owner, you can filter your gallery to see every photo that features a specific person.
home.faq6Q: Can I limit when guests can upload photos?
home.faq6A: Yes. Each album can have an open date and a close date. Uploads are automatically restricted to that window — no manual closing needed.
home.faq7Q: How do I download all the event photos?
home.faq7A: You can download all photos and videos as a single ZIP file from your gallery with one click.
home.faq8A: Yes. The Starter plan is free and includes 1 album and 5 GB of storage — enough to try Captura for a single event.
home.footerTagline: Crowd-sourced event photos, without the friction.
